mapper.sql: select id, token_hash, user_id, client_id, client_name, scope, resource, expires_at, revoked_at, create_ip, create_time, last_used_at from bi_mcp_token
mapper.insert: insert into bi_mcp_token (token_hash, user_id, client_id, client_name, scope, resource, expires_at, create_ip, create_time) values (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{clientId}, #{clientName}, #{scope}, #{resource}, #{expiresAt}, #{createIp}, sysdate())
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} and revoked_at is null and expires_at > sysdate() order by id desc
mapper.update: update bi_mcp_token set revoked_at = sysdate() where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and revoked_at is null
update bi_mcp_token set revoked_at = sysdate() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and revoked_at is null
update bi_mcp_token set last_used_at = sysdate() where id = #{id}
